newsitem.title: USA: Michael Foods, North Star move toward merger.
newsitem.headline: Michael Foods, North Star move toward merger.

text.p: Michael Foods Inc and North Star Universal Inc said Monday they have elected to proceed with the merger of the two companies without a ruling from the Internal Revenue Service on the tax consequences of the deal.

The two companies will instead proceed based on the receipt of a mutually acceptable opinion of certified public accountants as to the tax consequences of the transactions that will make up the merger, the companies said.
In a recent meeting with the IRS, the companies learned that it could take another six months or longer for the IRS to complete the ruling process, the companies said.
The transactions effecting the merger of the companies are expected to close in the first quarter of 1997, pending stockholder approvals and other closing conditions, the companies said.
